description: This file defines the SelectedItemsController class, which manages item selection state, interactions, and UI behaviors in a web application, including selection range, item opening, and persistence.

classes.name: SelectedItemsController
classes.description: Controller class managing selected items, their state, and related UI actions in a web app.

methods.name: getPersistableValue
methods.description: Returns the current selection state for persistence.

methods.name: hydrateFromPersistedValue
methods.description: Restores selection state from persisted data.

methods.name: setServicesPostConstruction
methods.description: Initializes the controller with an ItemListController and sets up item stream reactions.

methods.name: selectedItemsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of selected items.

methods.name: selectedFiles
methods.description: Returns the list of selected file items.

methods.name: selectedFilesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of selected files.

methods.name: firstSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the first selected item.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected items.

methods.name: getFilteredSelectedItems
methods.description: Filters selected items by content type.

methods.name: setSelectedItems
methods.description: Updates the selectedItems record based on current selectedUuids.

methods.name: setSelectedUuids
methods.description: Sets the selectedUuids set and updates selectedItems.

methods.name: removeSelectedItem
methods.description: Removes an item from selection by UUID.

methods.name: deselectItem
methods.description: Deselects a specific item.

methods.name: isItemSelected
methods.description: Checks if an item is selected.

methods.name: selectItemsRange
methods.description: Selects a range of items between indices.

methods.name: cancelMultipleSelection
methods.description: Cancels multi-selection mode.

methods.name: replaceSelection
methods.description: Replaces current selection with a specific item.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Selects all items.

methods.name: deselectAll
methods.description: Clears all selections.

methods.name: openSingleSelectedItem
methods.description: Opens the single selected item, if only one is selected.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Selects an item by UUID, handling multi-select logic.

methods.name: selectItemWithScrollHandling
methods.description: Selects an item and scrolls it into view if needed.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls the specified item into view.

methods.name: selectUuids
methods.description: Selects multiple items by their UUIDs.

methods.name: selectNextItem
methods.description: Selects the next item in the list.

methods.name: selectPreviousItem
methods.description: Selects the previous item in the list.
